module: rs.core.container.psm1 — Resolve-Layout(-Header [-Declaration] [-Columns] [-MetaFields]) → layout; then Measure-HeaderRow / Measure-Row / Render-HeaderRow / Render-Row (-Layout …) and Measure-Content / Encode-Content over the one codec table. FILED, NOT STARTED (shard-container-brief).
$comment: Export phase 0 — resolve the run's psr layout ONCE, before packing. Input is the admissible superset in schema/psr.header.json × run configuration (which optional columns / sub-fields are on) × the IR header (EntryCount → idx width). Output is the layout object that three stages consume: shards (Measure-Row sums), serialize (Render-Row writes), manifest (ColumnHeader declares). One declaration, one object, three `from` lines downstream — 'computed once, three sinks' is checkable here, not a discipline. In-memory only; nothing is written. Measure-* / Render-* are functions over (layout, entry), not shapes — their receipts are declared where they land (serialize.out.row).

Header.note: assemble.out.header — EntryCount and Elements are read (see in.header)

Declaration.note: schema/psr.header.json (default: beside the module). Admissible column superset, framing constants, types, wire-name map. READ BY CODE.

Columns.note: optional columns to enable: gidx, content_meta. Required columns (path, content_bytes, content) cannot be disabled; naming one is a no-op, naming an inadmissible one throws

MetaFields.note: content_meta sub-fields on, in psr.header.json order; default = its $default_on set. Inadmissible name throws

EntryCount.note: → IdxWidth = digits(EntryCount) when gidx is on; the bound known before packing that keeps rows measurable (ledger #46)

Elements.note: presence counts per element — used only to WARN when an enabled column's source is absent on some entries (those rows render the empty marker); never decides the layout

Columns.note: resolved columns in WIRE ORDER — required + enabled optional; content last, content_bytes immediately before it (psr.header.json invariants)

HeaderRowText.note: the header row as written (without terminator): names + type annotations, blocks with sub-fields, joined by the field delimiter

HeaderBytes.note: utf8(HeaderRowText) + terminator bytes; ONE constant per run, identical in every shard; seeds every shard's size in the plan

Framing.note: field delimiter, record terminator, block open/close/delimiter, empty marker, encoding (UTF-8, no BOM) — verbatim from psr.header.json

FloatPrecision.note: 4 — one deterministic formatter (invariant culture) for every float column

Width.note: fixed width (zero-padded) for position-dependent int columns; absent = variable

Source.note: in-memory origin — an entry path (RelativePath, ContentMeta.CharCount, Content via codec) or 'plan' (gidx, assigned after packing). This is the wire-naming map (PascalCase → snake_case), taken from psr.header.json

Fields.note: block sub-columns, one level deep, in declared order
